sloka: ततः कोप समाविष्टो विश्वमित्रो महामुनिः ।स्रुवम् उद्यम्य स क्रोधः त्रिशंकुम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-६०-१२॥
transliteration: tataḥ kopa samāviṣṭo viśvamitro mahāmuniḥ ।sruvam udyamya sa krodhaḥ triśaṁkum idam abravīt ॥1-60-12॥

translations.english: When, the gods invited by him did not come to receive their share of offerings, the great ascetic Viswamitra seized with anger lifted the sacrificial ladle and said to Trisanku:
